name: inertiaDeg_of_subsingleton
statement: p.IsMaximal] [hQ : Subsingleton (S ⧸ P)] : inertiaDeg p P = 0

name: inertiaDeg_le_inertiaDeg
statement: Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] [Module.Finite R T] (Q : Ideal T) [P.LiesOver p] [Q.LiesOver P] [p.IsPrime] : inertiaDeg P Q ≤ inertiaDeg p Q

name: absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg_of_liesOver
statement: Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDedekindDomain S] [Module.Free ℤ S] [IsDedekindDomain R] [Module.Free ℤ R] [Algebra S R] [Module.Finite S R] (P : Ideal R) (p : Ideal S) [P.LiesOver p] (hp : p.IsPrime) (hp_ne_bot : p ≠ ⊥) : absNorm P = absNorm p ^ (p.inertiaDeg P)

name: inertiaDeg_algebra_tower
statement: Ideal R) (P : Ideal S) (I : Ideal T) [p.IsMaximal] [P.IsMaximal] [P.LiesOver p] [I.LiesOver P] : inertiaDeg p I = inertiaDeg p P * inertiaDeg P I
